$comment: Documented §11.0 surface gaps (T-20261001-018). Each row: surface (registry name), check (instruction-file | platform-dir | skill-mirror | *), reason, fallback, ticket. A finding matching a row renders as WARN naming the ticket; every other finding is a FAIL (CONSTITUTION §11.0 rule 1 — never omit a surface silently).

gaps.reason: The Antigravity CLI-specific config path ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp_config.json (design Appendix B, ADR-0097) is not covered by install-upstream-mcp.ts, which registers the Antigravity family at the shared ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (CONSTITUTION §11.0 row 3/4). The CLI is expected to read the shared file (row 4 says shared with #3); the CLI-specific path is a fallback some builds use.
gaps.fallback: Antigravity CLI users on builds that only read the CLI-specific path register the server by hand or via the CLI's own mcp command; the shared registration covers the IDE and default CLI builds.
